prompt: Create a polished exact 1600x1000 desktop application UI mockup for Echo, an English Windows app for saving League of Legends clips. Direction A: ARCHIVE, quiet dark media catalogue for evening use. Realistic native desktop app, no browser chrome, no marketing hero, no gratuitous decoration. Elegant charcoal #121614, restrained mint #a6dfc6 accent, ivory text, muted sage secondary text, soft 12px corners. Slim 180px left sidebar with Echo wordmark and simple mint echo/play emblem, Library selected, Matches, Settings, footer 'Recorder ready'. Main center width 510px: title 'Your moments', filters All / Kills / Assists / Deaths, then clean 2-column media thumbnail grid showing illustrative League gameplay and small duration chips and titles Double kill, River skirmish, Last stand. Dates as quiet section separators. Right integrated large player width 800px showing a paused League battle, title 'River skirmish', Kill / Assist small labels, seek bar with colored event marks, play controls, clear trim handles and 'Export clip' button. Bottom of player a compact 'Selected range  00:12 — 00:35' strip. Top right a calm 'Waiting for League' status and small Record settings action, no giant record hero. Strong content hierarchy, precise alignment, readable typography, actual video content leads. Show believable full application screen with generous outer margin, no laptop/device. All data in the mockup is illustrative. NO glass, glow, gradients, gauges, charts, dashboard metrics or purple.
description: Illustrative design mockup, not an application screenshot.
